findings.body: This test requires a historical commit that CI does not fetch. `.github/workflows/forge.yml:19–21` and `.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:30–36` run the suite after checkout without overriding its [default fetch depth of 1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/actions/checkout/main/action.yml). Consequently, `git show` fails with `CalledProcessError` before any help or discovery assertions run. Make the independent baseline available in a shallow checkout, preferably as a committed test fixture.

findings.body: The promised declaration format accepts today's argument tuples, but `ast.literal_eval` cannot resolve callable values such as `int` ([Python contract](https://docs.python.org/3.11/library/ast.html#ast.literal_eval)). The existing `close --dismiss` option uses `type=int` at `src/forge/cli.py:49`. Putting its equivalent tuple into `COMMANDS` raises `ValueError` during parser construction, breaking every command, including `--help`. Support existing converter values and exercise a typed argument through the fixture command.
findings.title: Support existing argument converters in command declarations
